Purchase of Surface Disinfectant (Qty Required: 12000 nos) Specification 1) Packing Size: 01 liter each bottle 2) Active Ingredient - Stabilized hydrogen peroxide 10-11% w/v with diluted silver nitrate solution 3) Should be certified as hospital-grade disinfectant as per international standards e.g. CE certified (CE)/EN 93/42/EEC for medical devices. 4) Should be non-toxic and environment friendly. 5) The firm should submit all concerned certificates and material safety datasheet of the quoted product al ong with the quotation otherwise the quotation shall be considered invalid. 6) Supply of material is required in six equal installments. Buyer Added ATC Bid Security/Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) i) The Bid Security (EMD) for an amount mentioned in Tender Notice will have to be deposited & submitted with Technical Bid in the form of a Account Payee Demand Draft / deposit at call recei pt or an FDR/TDR or Banker’s Cheque or Bank Guarantee in original duly pledged in favour of Post graduate Institute of Medical Education and Research, Chandigarh and having its validity for at le ast One Year and issued by a Scheduled Commercial Bank. This bid security (EMD) may be attach ed with the Technical Bid. FDR/TDR issued for less amount and/or issued by Banks before the date of floating this NIT shall not be accepted & bids received with such FDR/TDR shall summarily be rej ected. Micro Small & Medium Enterprises as also startups as recognized by the department of MS ME are exempted for submission of EMD on production of requisite certificate. To safeguard against a bidder’s withdrawing or altering its bid during the bid validity period i n the case of advertised, Limited and Single Tender Enquiry, the bidders, except Micro and Small E nterprises (MSEs) and startups as defined in MSE Procurement Policy issued by Department of M icro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) or are registered with the Central Purchase Organizati on or the concerned Ministry or Department, shall submit Bid Security (EMD) with the technical bid which should be for an amount as requisitioned in this NIT. ii. Bid Security shall be accepted in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft, Fixed Deposit Re ceipt, Banker’s Cheque or Bank Guarantee, from any of the Scheduled Commercial Bank duly pled ged in favour of Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research, Chandigarh & to remai n valid for a period of ONE year taken from the date of floating tender by the Institute. Banks Gua rantee issued from the foreign banks must be authenticated by STATE BANK OF INDIA or any other Nationalized Bank of India. iii. Bid Security, if noticed tempered with and not found in order, shall not be accepted and suc h bids shall be liable to be rejected. iv Conditions for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) 1. As per Public Procurement Policy (PPP) for Micro & Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 issu ed vide Gazette Notification dated 23.03.2012 by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises of Govt of India, MSEs must be registered with any of the following in order to avail the benefits/pr eference available vide public Procurement Policy MSEs Order, 2012. a. District Industries Centers (DIC) b. Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) c. Khadi and Village Industries Board d. Coir Board e. National Small Industries Corporation (NSIC) f. Directorate of Handicraft and Handloom

g. Any other body specified by Ministry of MSME (MoMSME) h. Udyog Aadhar Acknowledgement/Udyog Aadhar Memorandum issued by MOMSME. 2. MSEs participating in the tender must submit valid & authorized copy of certificate of regist ration with any one of the above agencies. In case of bidders submitting DIC registration certificat e shall attach original notarized copy of the DIC certificate. The MSE’s Bidder to note and ensure t hat nature of services and goods/items manufactured mentioned in MSE’s as per MSE guidelines i ssued by MoMSME. 3. Under MSE category, only manufacturer for goods and service providers for services are elig ible for exemption from EMD. 4. Traders/Resellers/Distributors/Authorized agents will not be considered for availing benefits under PP Policy 2012 for MSEs as per MSE guidelines issued by MoMSME. 5. The registration certificate issued from any one of the above agencies must be valid as on Bi d Closing date of the tender. Bidder shall ensure validity of registration certificate in case bid closi ng date is extended. 6. The MSEs who have applied for registration or renewal of registration with any of the above agencies/bodies, but have not obtained the valid certificate as on close date of the tender are not eligible for exemption/preference. 7. The MSEs registered with above mentioned agencies/bodies are exempted from payment of Earnest Money Deposit (EMD). Micro and Small Enterprises are not exempted from performance s ecurity. Micro and Small Enterprises shall have to furnish performance security, if purchase order is placed with them. There is no relaxation in this regard. .
